notes: Lumen "Neon Lattice": four crystal pylons (N, E, S, W) round a core, joined by a 1px cyan lattice that splits the field into four sectors. On loop (8): the pylons light in sequence N, E, S, W (two frames each) with an arc crawling along the lattice edge to the next pylon and that sector's magenta lamp lit; the core facets turn clockwise while a 4-segment ring counter-rotates; the core breathes. hit (3): flare and ripple. recharge (4): ring and facets spinning up. Damaged: the west pylon is dark and cracked, a lattice edge flickers out, the core is chipped. Disabled: pylons dull, the north pylon snapped off, core shattered, every lattice line dead.
